author: fwyzard
body: #### PR description: Modify the `StreamerInputSource` to compare events' reduced process history ids (like PoolSource) instead of the full ids. This can speed up reading streamer files by 15%-25% in a busy job. The measurements in the plot are from the Phase-2 HLT running with 32 threads/32 streams over TTbar skimmed data, with CMSSW 20.1.0-pre4. The streamer files with LZ4 compression require #52217. (_the measurements are ongoing, the plot will be updated as they progress_) The effect is smaller with the parallel decompression and decoding in `NewEventStreamFileReader` implemented in #52146, but it still gives an improvement of the order of 10%: (_the measurements are ongoing, the plot will be updated as they progress_) #### PR validation: Unit tests pass. The functionality is confirmed by an additional dedicated test, not committed.
title: Compare reduced process ids reading streamer files
